findings.title: pr_seen doc says decide never acts on it
findings.detail:
Carried over from review #1, still not fixed. The comment says 'Decide never acts on it (its effects need a fresh pr)', but packages/core/src/decide/story.ts:542 now reads pr_seen to hold the stale gate. That read only waits (a noop) and never emits an effect.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Say that decide reads it only to wait for a sync, never to emit an effect.
